_comment: Spite already exists in data/content/spite.json as a weighted table of one-line drive-bys with a mechanical effect each — that is the random encounter *inside* an anomaly, and it stays exactly as it is. This is the other thing he is: an authored, once-only conversation on the front step, which hands over the town objective and the Finder. The two sit beside each other and share the character rather than the machinery. `mood` on a node names one of the alters in spite.json, so this is the same person in both places.

speakers.name: Spite
speakers.desc: The part of you that sneers. Not a villain — the loudest thing left over when you talk yourself out of something.

dialogues.speaker: spite
dialogues._comment: Beat 6. Forced, first run only, the moment the front door opens.

lines: Someone is sitting on your step with their back to the door. They do not get up.
"Four hundred and six," they say. "That's how many times you have opened that door. You always look so pleased with yourself about it."
"I'm Spite. You have heard the voice. This is the face that goes with it."
"Give or take. I stop counting when it starts getting embarrassing for you."
"You get further some times than others. You have never once got far enough."
They look at you for a long moment, and something in the face gives.
"Fine. You are not in the mood. Neither, frankly, am I."
"What do I want. I want you to stop stopping."
"Look at the town. Actually look at it. It is full of holes."
"Every one of them is a door into a version of you that did the thing. Shut them. All of them. Then we can have a conversation about the mountain."
"Enough that you will want to quit halfway. Not so many that quitting is reasonable."
"Because I am what is left over when you talk yourself out of things," they say. "There is a great deal of me. I would like there to be less."
They press something into your hand: a flat disc, warm, twitching very slightly, as though it is trying to point.
"It gets louder near a hole. It also lies. Not enough to be useless, just enough that you still have to walk."

effects.text: Spite presses the Finder into your hand.

replies.text: "I have been out past the foothills. I do not need a compass."

lines: "You have been past the foothills the way a stone has been past a window."
"Go on, then. I will be around."
